notes.title: my life effective from start to finish
notes.content:
It all started 4 and a half years ago at the end of 2019, almost 5 years that I have been alone I have the impression within myself that the world rejects me in the end that is not the case I had the motivation to create video games since I was little in my situation I am disabled but it does not hinder my work I am bipolar is scyzophrenic and paranoia in my life its difficult to overcome this I try not to think about it the support of my friends and people who understands my health concerns I currently have two Krone diseases and dystonia plus without counting heart problem followed for 2 years or even 4 years in the hospital for regular follow-up to help me get out I had rejection from my family because they I will consider myself incapable and a teenager from their point of view, with each failure I managed to get up every day and love what I love to do thank you to those who supported me and helped me overcome my difficulties in life throughout during the days I didn't have an easy childhood, I was always tied to the bed, people hit me to keep me quiet, I almost didn't leave my room, I tried to make friends when I was a kid, I didn't complain because it was useless, I learned from this not easy life and the disability is not a shame on the contrary it is a strength apart it is not a failure of life on the contrary it must be seen as a strong point I tell you this even if you have a family member or a friend who is disabled is not a shame thanks to my perseverance I was able to succeed in releasing a game on steam for a long time me of battle and perseverance thank you and thank you to the friends who support me and that I will not forget Never. strength to you.....


[previewyoutube=OB_QYKHmeCQ;full][/previewyoutube]



Sorry if this video is in French it's an association to help people in this situation like me I'm of the same opinion it's to show you that there is no shame in talking about it I am in difficulty current sociology thanks to this video it's my lot even help the YouTube channel that I have been subscribing to for six months, there is no point in denying these people, I will encourage them to the end.

[url=https://f-ms.fr/etablissement/savs-guider-vers-l-autonomie/]FMS (SAVS)[/url]
Well thank you to the organization of the FMS SAVS for allowing me to move forward and helping me with my work on point with the people who are trying to help me and it's a long job but it's worth it thank you.
